about: Homepage imagery (fluentia.academy). The set follows the page's night-to-dawn arc, and the progression is carried by the SHARE OF WARM LIGHT in the frame: problem none, trainer one small lamp, method a sliver, worth about half, CTA mostly warm. Each shot uses a different MODE so the page reads as a portfolio, not one theme repeated. Generated shots carry no people, no hands, no text. Platform visuals (unit covers, the phone screen) are REAL assets, listed under `real`, never generated. Prompts revised after art-director review 2026-09-15: no paper with marks (FLUX writes fake text), no precise spacing (the spaced-repetition visual is a CSS graphic, not a render), landmarks as silhouettes only, no 'glow', no film grain (seams against the flat page ground).
suffix: No people, no figures, no hands, no text, no letters, no words, no logos, no watermark.

shots.note: Render one seed with the suffix and one without; naming hands/letters can invite them.
shots.prompt: A cinematic still life on an old wooden desk at night, lit only by cold blue moonlight from a window. A plain unglazed matte stoneware mug of cold black coffee sits directly on the wood, no saucer. Beside it folded reading glasses rest on two closed notebooks with blank cloth covers and completely smooth spines — no printing, labels, engraving or maker's marks on any surface. Objects grouped in the middle third, dark space above and below. Deep midnight-blue grade, near-black shadows, one crisp azure highlight along the top notebook's edge. Editorial fine-art photograph, medium format, shallow depth of field.

shots.grade: night, azure screen light + one small warm lamp
shots.prompt: An online English trainer's desk at blue hour photographed from behind the laptop, so the camera sees only the dark matte back of the open screen lid; no screen surface visible anywhere in frame, its azure light spilling forward onto the desk and the wall as a soft cool wash. Beside it a neat stack of clothbound notebooks with ribbon bookmarks, a pencil, a small ceramic cup, and one brass desk lamp casting a single pool of amber light. Cool deep-blue room, dark overall, the lamp the brightest point. Editorial interior photograph, 35mm, shallow depth of field.

shots.grade: pre-dawn indigo, a sliver of warm light
shots.prompt: Two tiny Arabic finjan coffee cups on a dark walnut table, facing each other across it as if set for a conversation. Each cup is a small handleless porcelain bowl the size of an egg cup, with a plain rounded rim and absolutely no handle, no ear, no loop and no saucer — not a mug, not a teacup, not an espresso cup. They hold pale amber unmilked Arabic coffee, filled only a third, with a thin wisp of steam. A shallow dish of whole dark dates sits between them. Behind, unbroken deep indigo darkness with no lights or objects. A narrow sliver of warm amber light rakes in from the left and catches the cup rims and the table edge. Editorial still-life photograph, low eye-level, shallow depth of field.

shots.grade: pre-dawn blue, azure rim + a sliver of warm light
shots.prompt: A professional studio condenser microphone on a simple solid desk stand with no shock mount, a single wooden pencil lying beside the stand on a dark desk. The microphone's metal grille catches a crisp azure rim light from one side; the pencil sits in a narrow warm lamp light from the other side, just outside the frame. Dark pre-dawn blue room. Editorial still-life photograph, 50mm lens, shallow depth of field.

An empty two-lane road in central Saudi Arabia at first light, bending up through a pass in a pale limestone escarpment, across a buff gravel plain with a few scattered talh acacia trees. The escarpment edge catches pale gold light while the sky above is still deep blue, and the asphalt carries a thin line of reflected light. Long, quiet perspective; vast, calm and hopeful. Clear clean air. Editorial landscape photograph, telephoto compression, true colours.

A single-leaf traditional Najdi door of unpainted weathered wood, carved only with simple triangles and chevrons and no inscriptions, set in a thick mud-plaster wall at the end of a dim interior passage in old Diriyah. The door stands half open onto a sunlit mud-plaster courtyard wall, and bright warm first light pours through and lays a sharp-edged trapezoid of sunlight across the smooth earthen floor, while the near side of the passage rests in cool blue shadow. Architectural photograph, quiet and hopeful.

Looking up a narrow square stairwell of dark basalt-grey stone: six straight flights of real stair treads turning around an open rectangular shaft, one per storey, each landing a clear projecting ledge, rising toward a small distant skylight of pale morning sky. Lowest flights in near-black blue shadow, each flight higher catching slightly more cool light, only the topmost landing taking a faint warm gold edge. Skylight small, not blown out, frame predominantly dark. Dark minimal modern architecture, strong geometry. Architectural photograph, wide lens, symmetrical, from the bottom of the shaft.

shots.note: If 4 seeds fail the landmarks, use a licensed real photograph, graded to match; never ship a wrong Kingdom Centre. Placed as a 3:1 cut (focus y 0.62) on desktop and a 1:1 cut on phones, both faded into the page ground.
shots.prompt: A wide desert-city skyline at dawn seen from far across the plain. Two towers dominate as flat black silhouettes with no facade detail: on the left a slender rectangular tower whose upper third is pierced by a wide inverted-catenary arch spanned by a straight bridge; on the right a tapered four-sided pyramid tower carrying a single sphere just below its apex. No tower has a needle spire. The rest of the city is a low even band of small dark blocks with scattered warm window lights. The sky runs from near-black navy at the very top edge, through deep blue, to a narrow band of apricot and gold at the horizon only. The skyline occupies the lower 35 percent of the frame. Clear dry air, no haze. Wide cinematic telephoto landscape photograph, natural colour.
